title: Save Me from My Muse
note: Song 68, from the writer's muse poem. A punk waltz: fast 3/4 throughout, distorted downstroked guitars, kick on ONE and snare on two and three, gang vocals on the hook; comic on top, dark underneath; a high, bratty tenor. Lines 6-7 syllables, matched where they share a tune. Tempo and mode provisional. The real test of the engine in 3/4, made only after the 3/4 trial on song 53's words has been read. Not run. RUN COPY (28 Nov 12:30 ET): genre 'pop-punk' set to 'rock' for this run only, because the band writer's tables (studies/arrangement/lpd_band_tables.json) have no 'pop-punk' key; the melody reads genre only through FAMILY, where pop-punk and rock both map to 'other', so the melody is the same either way. The first attempt stopped at the band step with KeyError 'pop-punk' before any reading (void).
sections: Verse 1
I used to sleep like a stone
I used to answer the phone
now it's three in the morning
she comes in without warning
she says the song isn't done
and the song is never done
she leaves me wrecked on the floor
and grinning, ready for more
Chorus 1
She's got her hooks into me
the pages are flying
and inside I'm dying
and I'm fat on every word
so help me cook up a ruse
oh please save me from my muse
Verse 2
The coffee's cold in the cup
the dishes are stacking up
my wrist is wrapped in a brace
there's ink all over my face
she feeds me out of her hand
I eat more than I can stand
she gave me a song they know
I missed my own kid's school show
Chorus 2
She's got her hooks into me
the pages are flying
and inside I'm dying
and I'm licking the plate clean
somebody cook up a ruse
oh please save me from my muse
Verse 3
She laced me in bright red shoes
she said there's nothing to lose
I danced till the leather split
the red was mine, every bit
I begged her to cut them free
she laughed and danced on with me
they'll carry me out feet first
still dancing, fit to burst
Chorus 3
She's got her hooks into me
the pages are flying
and inside I'm dying
and I'm drunk on every drop
I'm begging you for a ruse
oh please save me from my muse
Bridge
I locked my pens in a drawer
and I went to bed at ten
the house was clean as a ward
I lay there sober and bored
I heard her scratch at the door
and I let her in again
Final chorus
She's got her hooks into me
the pages are flying
and inside I'm dying
and I'm licking the knife clean
so forget about the ruse
no, don't save me from my muse
